title: Super Green Vegan Pasta
subtitle: with Almonds and Gouda 'Cheese'
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you’re vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to the boil for the pasta. Cut the broccoli stem into 1cm chunks, then cut the head into small florets. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Coarsely grate the vegan gouda.

Cook pasta and peas: Cook the pasta in the pan of boiling water for 8 mins. Add the peas and cook for a further 2 mins or until the pasta is al dente and the peas are tender. Drain the pasta and peas.

Blend spinach: Meanwhile, crumble the stock cubes into a heatproof jug, add 125ml (½ cup) boiling water and stir to dissolve. Put the spinach in a large deep bowl and pour over the stock. Blend with a stick blender (see Make it yours) until smooth.

Cook broccoli: Put the almonds in a cold medium deep frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan. Heat 1 tbs olive oil in the pan over medium-high heat. Cook the broccoli, stirring occasionally, for 7 mins or until tender and lightly charred. Add the garlic and cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant.

Serve up: Add the pasta and peas and spinach mixture to the broccoli mixture. Cook, stirring, for 1 min or until combined and warmed through. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the pasta among bowls and scatter over the vegan gouda and almonds. Drizzle with 1 tbs olive oil and enjoy!
Make it yours: If you don't have a stick blender or food processor, simply stir the spinach and stock through the pasta (in Step 5) until the spinach is wilted and the mixture is well combined.
